sections.title: MSI Creator Z16
content: Experimente multitarea sin igual con la potencia del procesador Ryzen AI 9 365, alcanzando hasta 5GHz para aplicaciones exigentes. El MSI Creator Z16 te envuelve en su pantalla de 16" WQXGA con una tasa de refresco de 240Hz y una gama de colores DCI-P3 al cien por ciento. Además, con un SSD NVMe de 1TB y 32GB de memoria LPDDR5x-7500, asegura arranques instantáneos y manejo fluido para tus proyectos más grandes.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1699 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: UNMATCHED SPEED - Experience seamless multitasking with the AMD Ryzen AI 9 365 processor, clocking speeds from 2.0GHz to 5GHz, ensuring peak performance for demanding applications.
STUNNING VISUALS - Immerse yourself in the 16" WQXGA display with a 240Hz refresh rate, boasting a 100% DCI-P3 color gamut for vibrant and accurate color representation on an IPS-level panel.
AMPLE STORAGE - Enjoy lightning-fast data access and ample storage space with the 1TB NVMe SSD Gen4x4, providing quick boot times and rapid loading of applications and large files.
SMOOTH MULTITASKING - Equipped with 32GB of LPDDR5x-7500 memory, this workstation ensures smooth and efficient multitasking, handling multiple applications and large datasets with ease.
ADVANCED GRAPHICS - The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU with 8GB GDDR6 video memory delivers exceptional graphics performance, ideal for content creation, gaming, and professional applications.

sections.title: Dell XPS 15
content: -Lo que nadie te dice- sobre este portátil es cómo Windows 11 Pro, con su Copilot AI, revoluciona tu eficiencia diaria al planificar tareas y resumir contenidos por ti. Con su procesador Intel Core i5-1334U de última generación, tienes la potencia necesaria para multitarea intensiva y streaming fluido. La pantalla táctil IPS Full HD hace que cada presentación o diseño cobre vida con detalles vibrantes. Junto a sus impresionantes 20GB de RAM y un SSD PCIe de 512GB, estarás siempre preparado para mover archivos y aplicaciones a la velocidad del rayo.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1699 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: 🔹 13th Gen Intel Core i5 Performance for Smooth Productivity: The Dell Inspiron 15.6-inch laptop is powered by the latest Intel Core i5-1334U processor with 10 cores and up to 4.6GHz Turbo Boost, delivering fast, reliable performance for multitasking, streaming, and everyday workloads. Perfect for professionals, students, and creatives who need desktop-level speed in a portable form.

✨ 15.6" FHD IPS Touchscreen with Crisp, Vibrant Detail: Enjoy sharp visuals and smooth touch control on the 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) IPS touchscreen. With 220 nits brightness and slim bezels, the Dell laptop offers vivid color and clarity — ideal for work presentations, creative design, or entertainment.

⚙️ 20GB DDR4 RAM + 512GB PCIe SSD | Fast, Spacious, Ready to Go: Handle demanding tasks effortlessly with 20GB high-speed DDR4 memory and a 512GB PCIe SSD for lightning-fast boot-ups and file transfers.

🤖 Windows 11 Pro with Built-in Copilot AI for Smart Workflow: Work smarter with Windows 11 Pro and Copilot AI — your built-in assistant for drafting emails, summarizing content, and planning tasks. Enjoy advanced security, seamless productivity, and intuitive AI tools that make every workflow more efficient. Comes pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro.

📦 Sleek, Connected & Business-Ready: Dell Business Laptop stay productive with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 for fast, stable connections. The slim, modern design makes this Intel i5 laptop perfect for office, travel, or remote work.

features: Most powerful Surface laptop yet, with quad-core powered, 10th Gen Intel Core processors. More than 50% faster than Surface Book 2 13.5”.
Fastest graphics on Surface, powered by NVIDIA GTX GeForce GPU. 40% more graphics performance than Surface Book 2 13.5".
Power when you need it. Up to 15.5 hours battery life[1] — plus improved standby that extends battery life when you’re away.
Robust laptop, powerful tablet, and portable studio in one.
